data.name: Clemencia
data.gender_notes: Clemencia is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'clemens' which means 'merciful', 'compassionate', or 'mild'. In Christian tradition, it is the name of several saints and virtues. The name is often given to girls born in the springtime as a symbol of new beginnings and the hope for a compassionate and merciful future. The name Clemencia carries the meaning “Merciful and compassionate” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Clemencia usually hope their child will grow to embody merciful and compassionate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the spiritual trait of mercy, compassion, and forgiveness.
data.etymology: Clemencia belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Merciful and compassionate.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Clemencia total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
